gaps.sentence: I came ___ an old letter while clearing the attic.
The deal fell ___ at the last minute.
gaps.explanation: fall through = (a plan/deal) fail to happen.

gaps.sentence: An accident held ___ the traffic for two hours.
She cheered ___ when she heard the news.
gaps.explanation: cheer up = become happier (also transitive: cheer somebody up).

gaps.sentence: It took him weeks to get ___ the flu.
gaps.explanation: get over an illness/upset = recover from it.

gaps.sentence: Can we narrow the list ___ to three names?
gaps.explanation: narrow down = reduce the number of possibilities.

gaps.sentence: They broke ___ after only two years of marriage.
